concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-online-payments-surcharge]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured pilot API-only online-card surcharge guide for compliance gating, displayed amount, user/liable split booking and webhook/report reconciliation; examples are not enablement or bank-receipt proof.
warnings: Pilot access, API-only raw/encrypted card scope and platform-owned local/scheme compliance must be checked; `/cardDetails` does not automate a global legal decision, and raw card collection requires full PCI compliance.

Customer-paid surcharge, platform commission and transaction fees are distinct. Default surcharge destination is liable balance; explicit Surcharge split can target a user balance, and `/payments` amount includes the displayed surcharge. Adjustment/overcapture surcharges are excluded and the charge cannot exceed what was shown at purchase.

The surcharge split field table marks `amount.currency` required but the illustrated split JSON omits it; verify the actual API contract. Received/authorised/captured/booked sample webhooks and reporting lines distinguish states and are not bank-credit proof.
